about: Edit album's other parts (lib/tagEdit.ts, lib/trackInspector.ts, lib/trackFields.ts, lib/albumEdit.ts run as they are; components/TrackTagEditor.tsx's, app/EditPanel.tsx's and app/TrackInspector.tsx's words read out of their sources): Tags - the fields, shared values, edits, problems, notes, numbers and a track's page; Artwork and Lyrics (lib/getResults.ts, lib/lyrics.ts, components/LibraryParts.tsx's buttons) - when each Get is offered, its words, what it came to, and the pages' lines.

hint.words: Only the fields you change are written. Empty a field to remove that tag. No file is renamed and the folder stays where it is - the Release tab moves an album's folder to where its tags say it belongs.

Only the fields you change are written, to every track above. A field showing several values keeps each track’s own unless you type over it. Empty a field to remove that tag. No file is renamed and the folder stays where it is - the Release tab moves an album's folder to where its tags say it belongs.
